rule: Every Base stock whose Sunday 22:00 UTC weekend call is UP or DOWN (|DEX vs frozen Chainlink| ≥ 0.5%) gets a $1,000 paper position in that direction, entered at the Base DEX price and closed at the next regular-session open. No discretion, no sizing, no stops.

backtest.note: in-sample, before the rule went live; the rule was not changed after seeing it

notes: Positions, prices and P&L are computed in code. Each note is model-generated from those numbers (note_model_generated: true).
